top_signals.title: Legendary Entertainment Makes Bid for Lionsgate Studios
top_signals.summary: Legendary Entertainment has revived talks and made a takeover offer for Lionsgate Studios Corp. according to people familiar with the matter. Lionsgate is the studio behind movies such as The Hunger Games and John Wick. Chris Palmeri reports.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: University of Chicago Professor on What Made the US Economy Thrive
top_signals.summary: Professor James Robinson of the University of Chicago joins Joe Weisenthal and Tracy Alloway to discuss the role that inclusivity, innovation and creativity play in a successful economy and whether the US has become a failing state. They spoke on the Odd Lots podcast, recorded live at Chicago's City Winery. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Tesla-SpaceX: a huge corporate constellation with Musk at its centre
top_signals.summary: A merger of Elon Musk’s listed companies has some logic, but other shareholders might end up with less influence than they have today
